name: piloxa
description: Send a letter or document by real USPS Certified Mail to any U.S. address, and track it. Claude prepares the mailing and hands back a review link; the person reads the exact pages, checks the recipient and the one total, then pays and authorizes there. Nothing is printed, mailed or charged from inside the conversation. One page is $15.97 with the Electronic Return Receipt, $12.97 with tracking only, $24.21 with the Evidence Pack or $50.10 as a Deadline Notice; up to 10 pages.
